verdicts.reason: A uses a clear left-to-right banner order (logo, bottle, headline/body, CTA) with a strong headline, but it is crowded: 'fizz' runs into the stacked decorative circles, the CTA pill and the bottle sit almost against the canvas edges, and the body copy wraps to three ragged lines. B leaves more space and centres the headline well, but the SOLSTICE logo is squeezed against the top edge and almost touches the bottle cap, the bottle runs nearly edge to edge on the left, the body copy is shrunk to barely readable, and the centre band sits between empty areas.
